description: Angular component for managing a list of color ranges with support for advanced modes, drag-and-drop reordering, and form control integration.

classes.name: ColorRangeListComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and managing color range lists with advanced options and drag-and-drop functionality.

methods.name: advancedRangeValidator
methods.description: Validates that an AdvancedColorRange object has a color defined.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given value, handling simple and advanced range modes.

methods.name: addRange
methods.description: Adds a new color range, either simple or advanced based on the mode.

methods.name: removeRange
methods.description: Removes a color range at a specified index.

methods.name: addAdvancedRange
methods.description: Adds a new advanced color range with default constant types.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with current form values.
